Sunetra Pawar responds to Supriya Sule on Ajit Pawar death probe

Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar stated on Thursday that she, too, harbors suspicions about the plane crash that killed her husband, former Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar. She urged against politicizing the tragedy, responding to criticism from NCP (SP) working president Supriya Sule. Sule had reportedly commented on the ruling NCP enjoying power following Ajit Pawar's death and questioned the investigation. Sunetra Pawar countered that no one could feel Ajit Pawar's loss more than her family and expressed faith in the investigation agencies, asking that the incident not be politicized.
